law: Law 12: Fouls and Misconduct (direct free kick offences)
text: At 56', a foul moment involving C3 (Copperfield FC) against Westfield Rangers: a penalty kick was awarded. Measured contact was 0.54, sitting 0.00 below the judgement threshold, so the decision was close to the boundary. Under Law 12: Fouls and Misconduct (direct free kick offences): A direct free kick is awarded if a player commits any of a list of offences against an opponent in a manner considered careless, reckless or using excessive force - including trips, kicks, jumps at, charges, strikes, pushes and holds. Inside the penalty area, such an offence by the defending team is punished with a penalty kick instead. Carelessness is a judgement of degree: the referee weighs how much contact occurred and its consequence for the opponent. Contact near the threshold of a careless challenge can reasonably be judged either way at full speed.
